messages.subject: Format Percentage of Data table
parts:
Hi guys, 

I am trying to display one column of my data table as a percentage sign, similar to this blog: http://blog.rstudio.org/2015/06/24/dt-an-r-interface-to-the-datatables-library/.

I am using formatPercentage, but every time I try to type it out, I get an error of "R code execution error" [see attached image] and when I run the code with format percentage, it doesn't do any formatting to the column. 

Also I have already installed the most updated version of DT (dev tools). 

Any suggestions?

Thank you
